name: Rooted North Vineyards Tasting Room
description: The tasting room of Rooted North Vineyards (the new name for Suhru & Lieb) on Oregon Road in Cutchogue. Local singers and acoustic players perform on Friday evenings from 5 to 7 PM while guests sip wine at their tables.

dancing.notes: This is a seated wine tasting room with 90-minute table reservations, plus a patio and lawn in season. Friday music is a relaxed solo or acoustic set meant for listening. We found no sign of dancing.

evidence.note: Venue calendar lists a Friday music series from 5 to 7 PM with a different local solo performer each week into late fall 2026.
Visit page describes an indoor tasting room, a private library room and a patio, with reservations for 90-minute seatings.
September 2026 blog post explains that Suhru & Lieb became Rooted North and still welcomes guests at the same Oregon Road location.

reviewNotes: Added from the town-by-town source search (2026-10-05) for source rooted-north-vineyards-cutchogue. The winery renamed itself from Suhru & Lieb Vineyards in September 2026; older listings may use the old name.
